description: Reads a workbook. By default the whole current document as markdown, with its tabs. Narrow it with `tab`; a `section` (the prose under a heading, in your own words); a `table` (as data, in your own words); or `outline` for its headings, each with an `address` you can pass back to read just those. `version` reads an earlier version; `schema` returns its data-model rules; `notes` what its runs have learned about this account; `affected_by` every section an edit you describe would change.

address.description: An `address` an outline gave: just those sections.

affected_by.description: An edit, in your own words: answers with every section it would change.

notes.description: true for the notes its runs keep about this account.

outline.description: true for its headings only, each with an address.

schema.description: true for the workbook's schema: the rules every edit must hold.

section.description: Which section, in your own words.

table.description: Which table, in your own words.

name: read_workbook
title: Read a workbook
